reading: Of the 22 must-express facts, 10 are present semantically (4 outcomes, 2 time facts, appearance, sanity, personality, no-change) and 12 are absent or malformed.
None of the 9 moved facts is fully stated: 4 miss the origin, 1 misses the destination, 2 miss both, 1 only names the move, 2 conflate the same-name actors.
Every one of the 4 outcome facts is conveyed; only the frame misses. Relaxing the outcome frame would therefore flip 4 facts but still 0 samples, because a move fact always fails in the same text.
So the binding constraint is not wording: it is that the passage is never organised to carry the record's movement (origin and destination) and, in one case, the assignment of a subtask.
